jobs.title: Infant development program specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As an Infant Development Program Specialist, you’ll support infants and young children with developmental delays and disabilities through individualized, play-based learning. You’ll plan and deliver early intervention activities, partner with families, and coordinate with educators and other professionals to help each child build communication, social, cognitive, and motor skills. Your impact: By adapting instruction to each child’s needs and working closely with families, you help children participate more fully in everyday learning and routines.

**Responsibilities**

* Observe children’s development and use findings to guide lesson planning, curriculum development, and individualized education program (IEP) goals.
* Provide early intervention, preschool special education, and developmentally appropriate childcare, including toddler care when needed.
* Use classroom management and positive behavior management strategies; apply applied behavior analysis (ABA) principles when appropriate.
* Collaborate with families, speech therapy providers, and other professionals to coordinate student support.
* Maintain accurate records and follow applicable educational compliance requirements; use learning technology and standardized assessments as appropriate.

**Skills**

* Experience in early childhood education, classroom teaching, preschool, daycare, childcare, or private school settings; experience working with children and students with disabilities or developmental delays is valuable.
* Knowledge of special education, deaf education, literacy education, math, childhood development, child welfare, and special education law is an asset.
* Familiarity with behavioral therapy, behavior support for students with special needs, physical education, and teaching students with developmental disabilities is preferred.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with families and multidisciplinary teams.
* Understanding of educational regulations and experience supporting children with autism or other developmental disabilities is preferred.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sherman Oaks, CA 91423

jobs.title: Account Opener | Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Build Relationships. Open Doors. Create Opportunities.**

Are you confident approaching business owners, starting conversations, and turning new connections into business opportunities?

**We're looking to partner with ambitious, entrepreneurial professionals who are ready to take ownership of their future, build meaningful business relationships, and create something of their own—with the support of an established company.**

Colonial Life's Southern California team is growing and we're looking for motivated, outgoing individuals who enjoy building relationships, developing new business, and taking initiative.

We value **performance, character, and potential over traditional career backgrounds.** We're seeking team players, self-starters, and emerging leaders who demonstrate integrity, a commitment to exceptional service, and a genuine desire to grow both personally and professionally.

As an **Account Opener**, your primary focus will be identifying prospective employer groups, connecting with business decision-makers and establishing new business accounts.

**This is a business-to-business prospecting and account development opportunity.** Successful candidates must be comfortable with cold calling, in-person field canvassing, industry networking and actively pursuing new business relationships.

**Who Is Colonial Life?**

Founded in 1939, Colonial Life began by offering life and accident insurance policies. In 1955, the company pioneered worksite marketing by offering employees benefits through payroll deduction.

Today, Colonial Life offers a diverse portfolio of voluntary benefits, including accident, cancer, disability, life, and dental insurance. We help employers identify opportunities to strengthen their employee benefits packages and provide financial protection for their workforce.

With more than 80 years of experience, Colonial Life fosters a culture of integrity, collaboration, innovation, and growth, supporting independent agents throughout their professional journey.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify, research, and prospect new business opportunities throughout Southern California.
* Conduct cold calling and in-person field canvassing to introduce Colonial Life to prospective employer groups.
* Visit local businesses and initiate conversations with business owners, HR professionals, and other decision-makers.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective employer accounts.
* Identify employer needs and opportunities for supplemental employee benefits.
* Schedule and conduct introductory meetings with prospective business clients.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with potential and existing business contacts.
* Utilize CRM and prospecting resources to organize leads, document conversations, and manage follow-up activities.
* Collaborate with experienced territory professionals to help secure new employer accounts.
* Coordinate with trained Benefits Specialists and Enrollers who can conduct employee benefit presentations and individual enrollment sessions after an employer account is established.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Willingness to cold call, prospect, and conduct field canvassing on a regular basis.**
* Confidence approaching businesses and initiating conversations with decision-makers.
* Professionalism and integrity in all business interactions.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivation, initiative, and a strong work ethic.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* A positive attitude, coachability, and a willingness to learn.
* Previous experience in B2B sales, outside sales, customer relations, or business development is beneficial.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Insurance Licensing Requirements**

A California Accident and Health or Sickness insurance license is required for this opportunity. Candidates who are not currently licensed must be willing to obtain the necessary license.

If you are not currently licensed, you must be prepared to complete the licensing process and personally cover the associated expenses, including:

* Required licensing examinations and examination scheduling fees.
* Fingerprinting and applicable background-check fees.
* State insurance license application fees.
* Any required licensing education or preparation expenses.

Candidates must be willing to complete the licensing requirements in a timely manner. Guidance regarding the licensing process and available training resources will be provided.

For additional information, visit the *California Department of Insurance – Individual Resident Application Procedures*.

**What This Opportunity Provides**

* **Integrity in All That We Do:** Partner with an established company committed to professionalism, ethical business practices, and helping others.
* **Dedicated Enrollment Support:** Access to trained Benefits Specialists and Enrollers who can conduct employee benefit presentations, provide individual benefit consultations, and assist with employee enrollments once an employer account is established. This allows Account Openers to focus on building employer relationships, developing new business, and opening additional accounts.
* **Company-Provided Leads & CRM Technology:** Access to prospecting leads and Colonial Life-provided CRM technology at no cost, accessible through a laptop or mobile application to manage prospects, track business activity, and conduct follow-ups while in the field.
* **Complimentary Marketing & Prospecting Materials:** Access to company-produced marketing materials, including brochures, product flyers, and business drop materials, available to order and have shipped directly to your home at zero cost.
* **Local Office Space & Territory Resources:** Access to unique Southern California Territory resources, including office space available for use

jobs.title: Italian Food Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Varuni Napoli is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Italian Food Procurement Coordinator to support the purchasing and sourcing of food ingredients, kitchen supplies, and restaurant essentials. This role focuses on coordinating supplier orders, monitoring inventory requirements, maintaining purchasing records, and helping ensure that high-quality ingredients are available to support daily restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate has strong communication and organizational skills, an understanding of food procurement processes, and an interest in Italian cuisine and restaurant supply management.

Common Job Roles

* Italian Food Procurement Coordinator
* Restaurant Purchasing Coordinator
* Food Sourcing Associate
* Culinary Supply Coordinator
* Procurement Operations Specialist
* Restaurant Inventory Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate purchasing activities for food ingredients, beverages, packaging, and kitchen supplies.
* Communicate with approved suppliers regarding pricing, product availability, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment based on restaurant requirements.
* Assist with sourcing fresh produce, cheeses, flour, pasta ingredients, sauces, and other Italian food essentials.
* Review purchase requests and help prepare and track purchase orders.
* Maintain accurate records of supplier information, purchasing transactions, and deliveries.
* Verify incoming shipments against purchase orders and report discrepancies.
* Work with kitchen managers to understand ingredient specifications and quality expectations.
* Help compare supplier quotations and identify opportunities for cost-effective purchasing.
* Track delivery delays, shortages, and product substitutions, escalating issues when necessary.
* Support appropriate storage and inventory rotation for perishable and nonperishable products.
* Follow company purchasing procedures and applicable food safety requirements.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, inventory management, logistics, or restaurant operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of food ingredients and restaurant supply requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and supplier coordination abilities.
* Familiarity with purchase orders, inventory records, and basic cost tracking.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and standard office software.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet purchasing deadlines.
* Problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with kitchen and management teams.
* Familiarity with Italian cuisine or specialty food sourcing is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

* Food procurement and supplier coordination
* Ingredient sourcing and quality awareness
* Inventory monitoring and replenishment
* Purchase order management
* Cost comparison and recordkeeping
* Delivery scheduling and logistics coordination
* Food storage and inventory rotation
* Time management and teamwork

Work Environment

This position supports restaurant purchasing and inventory operations. The coordinator may work in an office or restaurant setting and communicate regularly with suppliers, kitchen staff, restaurant managers, and delivery personnel. The role requires careful recordkeeping, timely follow-up, and attention to ingredient quality and availability.

Career Progression

With experience and strong performance, this role may lead to opportunities such as Senior Procurement Coordinator, Food Purchasing Specialist, Supply Chain Supervisor, Procurement Manager, or Restaurant Operations Manager.

About the Company

Varuni Napoli is an Atlanta-based Italian restaurant known for its Neapolitan-style pizza and Italian-inspired menu. Effective procurement coordination helps support ingredient quality, reliable supply availability, and smooth restaurant operations.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a résumé highlighting relevant experience in food purchasing, supplier communication, inventory management, procurement, or restaurant operations. Experience with fresh ingredients, specialty food products, and purchase order systems should be included where applicable.

**Note:** This is a sample Indeed-style job post based on the company name and job title provided. It does not confirm that Varuni Napoli currently has this specific position available.

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

GitGuardian helps enterprises close credential-based breach paths. The GitGuardian platform is already used by more than 600K developers worldwide and by 50 of the Fortune 500!

**About your team and your mission**
------------------------------------

Our Growth market segment covers companies with up to 1,000 employees. It’s a fast-moving, high-volume space where strong outbound instincts and a relentless prospecting mindset make all the difference.

You will join our Business Development team in New York or Boston, working closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Jason, our Head of Business Development. More than 70% of our customers are in the US, so you’ll be at the heart of our largest market.

This is a high-velocity role. Your main mission is to generate qualified pipeline by finding and engaging security, engineering, and DevOps decision-makers at companies that could benefit from GitGuardian. You will be the first touchpoint for many of our future customers.

-------------

*If you think you match at least 70% of these criteria, please apply!*

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

* You are a hunter and find creative ways to prospect and engage the targeted profiles.

* Positivity, coachability, and a willingness to grow in the role.

*A conversation with* Jason, Head of Business Development *to learn more about your achievements and introduce you to the team and the role.*

**4.1 Executive interview**  
A final interview with Rachel, our VP GTM Americas, and/or Eric, our CEO, to go over our company’s vision and ambitions for the global sales team.

**4.2 Reference check**  
Start thinking about two people who can speak to your previous or current professional experience. They should be as recent as possible, and we will call them at the end of the process.

And also...

**What we look for**

* Experience managing US clients
* Comfortable discussing data, analytics, or cloud projects with technical and business people

new_jobs.title: Account Opener | Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Build Relationships. Open Doors. Create Opportunities.**

Are you confident approaching business owners, starting conversations, and turning new connections into business opportunities?

**We're looking to partner with ambitious, entrepreneurial professionals who are ready to take ownership of their future, build meaningful business relationships, and create something of their own—with the support of an established company.**

Colonial Life's Southern California team is growing and we're looking for motivated, outgoing individuals who enjoy building relationships, developing new business, and taking initiative.

We value **performance, character, and potential over traditional career backgrounds.** We're seeking team players, self-starters, and emerging leaders who demonstrate integrity, a commitment to exceptional service, and a genuine desire to grow both personally and professionally.

As an **Account Opener**, your primary focus will be identifying prospective employer groups, connecting with business decision-makers and establishing new business accounts.

**This is a business-to-business prospecting and account development opportunity.** Successful candidates must be comfortable with cold calling, in-person field canvassing, industry networking and actively pursuing new business relationships.

**Who Is Colonial Life?**

Founded in 1939, Colonial Life began by offering life and accident insurance policies. In 1955, the company pioneered worksite marketing by offering employees benefits through payroll deduction.

Today, Colonial Life offers a diverse portfolio of voluntary benefits, including accident, cancer, disability, life, and dental insurance. We help employers identify opportunities to strengthen their employee benefits packages and provide financial protection for their workforce.

With more than 80 years of experience, Colonial Life fosters a culture of integrity, collaboration, innovation, and growth, supporting independent agents throughout their professional journey.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify, research, and prospect new business opportunities throughout Southern California.
* Conduct cold calling and in-person field canvassing to introduce Colonial Life to prospective employer groups.
* Visit local businesses and initiate conversations with business owners, HR professionals, and other decision-makers.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective employer accounts.
* Identify employer needs and opportunities for supplemental employee benefits.
* Schedule and conduct introductory meetings with prospective business clients.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with potential and existing business contacts.
* Utilize CRM and prospecting resources to organize leads, document conversations, and manage follow-up activities.
* Collaborate with experienced territory professionals to help secure new employer accounts.
* Coordinate with trained Benefits Specialists and Enrollers who can conduct employee benefit presentations and individual enrollment sessions after an employer account is established.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Willingness to cold call, prospect, and conduct field canvassing on a regular basis.**
* Confidence approaching businesses and initiating conversations with decision-makers.
* Professionalism and integrity in all business interactions.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivation, initiative, and a strong work ethic.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* A positive attitude, coachability, and a willingness to learn.
* Previous experience in B2B sales, outside sales, customer relations, or business development is beneficial.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Insurance Licensing Requirements**

A California Accident and Health or Sickness insurance license is required for this opportunity. Candidates who are not currently licensed must be willing to obtain the necessary license.

If you are not currently licensed, you must be prepared to complete the licensing process and personally cover the associated expenses, including:

* Required licensing examinations and examination scheduling fees.
* Fingerprinting and applicable background-check fees.
* State insurance license application fees.
* Any required licensing education or preparation expenses.

Candidates must be willing to complete the licensing requirements in a timely manner. Guidance regarding the licensing process and available training resources will be provided.

For additional information, visit the *California Department of Insurance – Individual Resident Application Procedures*.

**What This Opportunity Provides**

* **Integrity in All That We Do:** Partner with an established company committed to professionalism, ethical business practices, and helping others.
* **Dedicated Enrollment Support:** Access to trained Benefits Specialists and Enrollers who can conduct employee benefit presentations, provide individual benefit consultations, and assist with employee enrollments once an employer account is established. This allows Account Openers to focus on building employer relationships, developing new business, and opening additional accounts.
* **Company-Provided Leads & CRM Technology:** Access to prospecting leads and Colonial Life-provided CRM technology at no cost, accessible through a laptop or mobile application to manage prospects, track business activity, and conduct follow-ups while in the field.
* **Complimentary Marketing & Prospecting Materials:** Access to company-produced marketing materials, including brochures, product flyers, and business drop materials, available to order and have shipped directly to your home at zero cost.
* **Local Office Space & Territory Resources:** Access to unique Southern California Territory resources, including office space available for use

new_jobs.title: Italian Food Procurement Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Varuni Napoli is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Italian Food Procurement Coordinator to support the purchasing and sourcing of food ingredients, kitchen supplies, and restaurant essentials. This role focuses on coordinating supplier orders, monitoring inventory requirements, maintaining purchasing records, and helping ensure that high-quality ingredients are available to support daily restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate has strong communication and organizational skills, an understanding of food procurement processes, and an interest in Italian cuisine and restaurant supply management.

Common Job Roles

* Italian Food Procurement Coordinator
* Restaurant Purchasing Coordinator
* Food Sourcing Associate
* Culinary Supply Coordinator
* Procurement Operations Specialist
* Restaurant Inventory Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate purchasing activities for food ingredients, beverages, packaging, and kitchen supplies.
* Communicate with approved suppliers regarding pricing, product availability, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment based on restaurant requirements.
* Assist with sourcing fresh produce, cheeses, flour, pasta ingredients, sauces, and other Italian food essentials.
* Review purchase requests and help prepare and track purchase orders.
* Maintain accurate records of supplier information, purchasing transactions, and deliveries.
* Verify incoming shipments against purchase orders and report discrepancies.
* Work with kitchen managers to understand ingredient specifications and quality expectations.
* Help compare supplier quotations and identify opportunities for cost-effective purchasing.
* Track delivery delays, shortages, and product substitutions, escalating issues when necessary.
* Support appropriate storage and inventory rotation for perishable and nonperishable products.
* Follow company purchasing procedures and applicable food safety requirements.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, inventory management, logistics, or restaurant operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of food ingredients and restaurant supply requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and supplier coordination abilities.
* Familiarity with purchase orders, inventory records, and basic cost tracking.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and standard office software.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet purchasing deadlines.
* Problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with kitchen and management teams.
* Familiarity with Italian cuisine or specialty food sourcing is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

* Food procurement and supplier coordination
* Ingredient sourcing and quality awareness
* Inventory monitoring and replenishment
* Purchase order management
* Cost comparison and recordkeeping
* Delivery scheduling and logistics coordination
* Food storage and inventory rotation
* Time management and teamwork

Work Environment

This position supports restaurant purchasing and inventory operations. The coordinator may work in an office or restaurant setting and communicate regularly with suppliers, kitchen staff, restaurant managers, and delivery personnel. The role requires careful recordkeeping, timely follow-up, and attention to ingredient quality and availability.

Career Progression

With experience and strong performance, this role may lead to opportunities such as Senior Procurement Coordinator, Food Purchasing Specialist, Supply Chain Supervisor, Procurement Manager, or Restaurant Operations Manager.

About the Company

Varuni Napoli is an Atlanta-based Italian restaurant known for its Neapolitan-style pizza and Italian-inspired menu. Effective procurement coordination helps support ingredient quality, reliable supply availability, and smooth restaurant operations.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a résumé highlighting relevant experience in food purchasing, supplier communication, inventory management, procurement, or restaurant operations. Experience with fresh ingredients, specialty food products, and purchase order systems should be included where applicable.

**Note:** This is a sample Indeed-style job post based on the company name and job title provided. It does not confirm that Varuni Napoli currently has this specific position available.

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person
